lessons.objectiveEnglishSource: Check on crew hydration and heat symptoms
lessons.speakingEnglishSource: Ask a worker how they feel and direct a water break under the site heat plan.

words.en: Take a water break every hour.
Go to the shade and rest.
Tell me if you feel sick.

readingEnglish: It is very hot and the sun beats down on the roof.
The foreman says: Take a water break every hour.
But Raúl does not look well, and the foreman walks over.
The foreman asks him: How do you feel?
Are you dizzy?
Raúl answers yes, a little.
The foreman tells him: Go to the shade and rest. Drink water now.
Tell me if you feel sick, and we will follow the site heat plan.
Hydration and rest in the shade help prevent heat exhaustion.

verbs.exampleEnglish: Raúl rests in the shade because he feels dizzy.

verbs.meaningEnglish: to let know, to tell, to notify
verbs.exampleEnglish: Raúl tells the foreman if he feels sick.
Raúl goes to the shade to rest.

lessons.objectiveEnglishSource: Keep workers below clear of debris
lessons.speakingEnglishSource: Tell the ground crew to move clear before tear-off resumes.

words.en: Keep the ground crew clear of falling debris.
Wait until I say it's clear.

readingEnglish: Before continuing with the tear-off, the foreman talks to the ground crew.
Debris can fall from the roof and hurt someone below.
Put up the warning tape around the exclusion area.
Move away from the house.
Don't stand under the work, even if you are wearing a hard hat.
Keep the ground crew clear of falling debris.
If you use the debris chute, warn people first: Heads up! Debris coming down!
Wait until I say it's clear.

verbs.exampleEnglish: We put up the warning tape around the exclusion area.
Everyone moves away from the house before the tear-off.
We wait until the foreman says it's clear.
If we use the debris chute, we warn people first.

lessons.objectiveEnglishSource: Describe and record a repaired deck section
lessons.speakingEnglishSource: Ask for a photo of a deck repair before the crew covers it.

words.en: Take a photo of the repaired area before covering it.
Take a photo before and after the repair.
Do not cover it until I check it.
How big is the repaired section?

readingEnglish: During the tear-off, the crew found a damaged area on the deck.
The foreman says: Show me the damaged area.
Take a photo before and after the repair.
The workers replace the damaged plywood.
The foreman asks: How big is the repaired section?
A worker measures the section and gives the measurement.
Take a photo of the repaired area before covering it.
Do not cover it until I check it.
The repair photo is the record of what stays in the covered area.

verbs.exampleEnglish: The workers take a photo before and after the repair.
A worker shows the damaged area to the foreman.
The workers replace the damaged plywood.
A worker measures the section and gives the measurement.
The foreman checks the repaired section before covering it.
